# <chat-bubble>

Content wrapper for chat messages with typography, code block styling, and CSS-only typing dots animation.

- CSS-only custom element. Works without JavaScript.
- Documentation: https://vanilla-breeze.com/docs/elements/custom-elements/chat-bubble/
- Vanilla Breeze 0.7.4

## Example

```html
<chat-bubble>
  <p>Paragraph content with <strong>formatting</strong>.</p>
</chat-bubble>
```
